answers.core: As a fundamental geometrical function, it would be logical to add in the Geometry singleton, as similar functions for polygons like clipping can be found there, too.
answers.workaround: While there might be, I have not found one that works well in GDscript.A brute force solution (of o(n2) computing time) could be achieved in GDScript by checking all polygon segments of a polygon p against all others; or by implementing a sweep line algorithm in GDscript; but these are presumably slow options, especially if the code wishes to deal with dozens or hundreds of such polygons.

title: Add a function to Geometry to check if a polygon is self-intersecting (ie. simple/non-simple)
